title: Barley for the Brewer
offer: Orm of Hallvik wants the biggest barrel of ale for the autumn feast. I need grain, five crates! Bring them, and you get two crates of my ale.

steps.say: Into the water with it, let it sprout... In a week, the best ale of the lakes!

fact: Ale was brewed from barley and water, often with herbs instead of hops.
